description: Drill Down Pie PRO is a performance-aware pie visual for Power BI, designed for change reporting rather than simple category breakdowns. It combines drill down interaction, category level targets, and automatic "others" directly on the pie. This removes the need for separate comparison visuals, tooltip explanations, or workaround measures. The result is a single visual that clearly communicates distribution, performance change, and target alignment at a glance. Why choose Drill Down Pie PRO Standard Power BI pie charts fall short when reports need to explain performance, not just proportions. Drill Down Pie PRO is built for reports where users need to: Compare actuals versus targets per category Understand performance change directly on the visual Reduce report clutter by avoiding multiple visuals Easier exploration with one-click drill downs and cross-chart filtering Build reports that remain understandable after handover to other developers Key features ADVANCED DRILL DOWN INTERACTION - users can explore up to 9 levels of data step by step without losing context. Drill down actions preserve KPI visibility and visual clarity during navigation. Cross-filter chart with a single click.
